test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **"within".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **"Within" **is the most appropriate preposition to use in this context.
 
• It means **"inside" **or "not exceeding a certain time frame".
 
 
• **Example: **"The package will be delivered within 3 days."
